title: How Cedar Hollow got its afternoons back · proof

comments.text: Check: This says CARA texts families on its own. The rule is that AI work that can be fixed afterward can happen automatically, like the note going onto the case, but a text to a client can't be taken back, so a person approves the exact message first. Suggest: cut it, or say the caseworker approves each recap before it is sent.

Check: An unsupported superlative, passed on second-hand from one remark on the call, with no source behind it. Suggest: cut it, or quote a named (fictional) staff member saying what changed for them.
Check: An outcome claim from one remark, with no figure and no source behind it. Suggest: cut it until there are turnover figures.
